 Order
By way of present petition filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the petitioner seeks quashing of the FIR No.228/2016 registered under Sections 376/506 IPC at P.S. North Rohini, Delhi.
2. Notice of the petition was issued to the complainant however, as per the status report, she couldn't be served as I.O. is unaware of the whereabouts of the complainant.
Further efforts to collect the whereabouts of the complainant from her father were also not fruitful.
Let the complainant/respondent No.2 be served through the concerned DCP.

3. Renotify on 22.03.2024.
MANOJ KUMAR OHRI, J JANUARY 16, 2024 ga
